description: Provides an answer slot for text, images or drawings.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
Title
Match the answers
Prompt
Choose an answer for each blank.
Answers
  1. Paris
Form

The capital of France:

A shape with three sides:

The library logo:

Feedback
Match each answer to its description.
Solution
Paris; the triangle; the tp-components logo.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name forwarded to the editing control; use it when the field has no visible label.

attributes.name: closed
attributes.description: Uses an answer-bank destination unless the question overrides the mode.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name used by tp-fill-blank form data.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Text displayed while the blank is empty.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Open field type: text, number, math, date, or time.

methods.name: clear(): void
methods.description: Empties the blank and notifies its form.

methods.name: setAnswer(value: string, content: Node): void
methods.description: Assigns an identity and clones its visual content without moving the source.

methods.name: syncMode(): void
methods.description: Reconciles the local control with the nearest question without changing author attributes.

events.name: input
events.description: Emitted when an answer is assigned or cleared; read the updated answer from value.

events.name: tp-blank-mode-change
events.description: Emitted when closed or type changes while connected, after the blank has been rendered in its new mode.

cssproperties.name: --tp-blank-filled-border-color
cssproperties.description: Bottom border color of a blank after an answer has been filled in.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-blank>` element provides an answer slot for text, images or drawings.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Open field | Enter an answer using the control selected by its type. |
| Closed destination | Select an answer from the bank or drag it onto the blank. |
| Answer then blank | Select an answer and click the destination, or drag the answer onto it. |
| Clear | Release the assigned answer; unavailable when empty or disabled. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Focus a target blank. |
| <kbd>ArrowRight</kbd> | Move from the blank to the answer bank. |
| <kbd>Up</kbd> / <kbd>Down</kbd> | Choose an answer. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Assign the chosen answer to the highlighted blank. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Cancel. |
| <kbd>Delete</kbd> / <kbd>Backspace</kbd> | Clear the focused blank. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
